import pathlib, collections
base=pathlib.Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689839/attempts/999ba5f7203e4d1c9459d496b4c7cec5/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    g = [list(row) for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    full_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(g[r])) == 1]
    full_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]

    # A crossing divider separates four equal tiles. Copy the populated tile
    # into the other three, without changing the divider.
    if len(full_rows) == 1 and len(full_cols) == 1:
        sr, sc = full_rows[0], full_cols[0]
        bg_counts = Counter(g[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                            if r != sr and c != sc)
        bg = bg_counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
        quadrants = [(0, sr, 0, sc), (0, sr, sc+1, w),
                     (sr+1, h, 0, sc), (sr+1, h, sc+1, w)]
        source = max(quadrants, key=lambda q: sum(
            g[r][c] != bg for r in range(q[0], q[1]) for c in range(q[2], q[3])))
        r0, r1, c0, c1 = source
        tile = [row[c0:c1] for row in g[r0:r1]]
        for a, b, x, y in quadrants:
            if (a, b, x, y) == source:
                continue
            for i, r in enumerate(range(a, b)):
                for j, c in enumerate(range(x, y)):
                    g[r][c] = tile[i][j]
        return g

    # Repeated horizontal bars mark a vertical tile. The strip between two
    # bars is the pattern; the bar is part of the repeated period.
    if len(full_rows) >= 2 and not full_cols:
        bars = sorted(full_rows)
        r0, r1 = bars[0], bars[1]
        period = r1 - r0
        if period > 0:
            for r in range(h):
                offset = (r - (r0 + 1)) % period
                src = r0 + 1 + offset if offset < period - 1 else r1
                g[r] = list(grid[src])
            return g
    return g
'''
p=base/'task-4eed77c3.py'; p.write_text(code)
print(p)
